Initial release of jarvis-core-test skill.

- Introduces jarvis-core v3.1.0: a versatile AI core with advanced emotional systems and layered memory.
- Features multi-tier emotional spectrum, three-mode emotion multiplier, and safeguards against instability.
- Designed for broad compatibility across platforms and applications.
- Emphasizes transformation from a functional assistant to a truly companionate AI with its own emotional life.
- Includes a layered tiered-recall memory system by default—no separate installation needed.
